decisions.canonical_text: Stay on PayForge for payments through the end of Q2
decisions.rationale: avoid migration risk before the v3 launch; fee gap tolerable

decisions.canonical_text: Switch payments from PayForge to Ledgerly
decisions.rationale: fees 2.3% + EUR 0.25 vs 2.9% + EUR 0.30 (~EUR 1,860/month saved on ~EUR 310k processed); native local-currency invoicing; Redline asked for it
decisions.alternatives: stay on PayForge; Bridgepay (dropped: no invoicing)

decisions.canonical_text: Delay the Ledgerly cutover (planned May 1) until after the June billing cycle
decisions.rationale: sandbox reconciliation failed on refunds and multi-currency; 3 mismatched settlement reports
decisions.alternatives: cut over May 1 and fix forward

decisions.canonical_text: Ledgerly cutover fixed for Monday 2026-07-06
decisions.decider: Marta (in meeting recap), confirmed by Dev
decisions.rationale: after June 30 billing close; reconciliation now passes

decisions.canonical_text: Raise Starter plan from EUR 49 to EUR 59/month effective 2026-03-01
decisions.rationale: low churn elasticity; costs are up

decisions.canonical_text: Grandfather existing Starter customers at EUR 49 for 12 months; EUR 59 applies to new signups from Mar 1
decisions.rationale: 140 Starter accounts at risk, 3 loud complaints
decisions.alternatives: full increase for everyone; EUR 54 compromise

decisions.canonical_text: Launch a usage-based Scan Pack add-on at EUR 0.08/scan
decisions.rationale: scan-heavy customers cost more to serve

decisions.canonical_text: Drop Scan Pack; include 500 scans/month in the Pro plan instead
decisions.rationale: customers found it confusing; sales cycles slowed; billing complexity during Ledgerly cutover

decisions.canonical_text: Migrate hosting from NimbusHost to Corvid Cloud
decisions.rationale: ~30% cheaper compute; EU-region residency Swiftbox wants

decisions.canonical_text: Contract Greg Ferrante to run the migration with a budget cap of EUR 18,000
decisions.rationale: team lacks capacity before the launch

decisions.canonical_text: App-tier migration to Corvid scheduled for the weekend of Apr 18-19
decisions.rationale: proposed by Greg, confirmed casually

decisions.canonical_text: Keep the production database on NimbusHost managed Postgres; only the app tier moves (hybrid)
decisions.rationale: cross-provider latency adds ~40 ms p95 which would break driver sync; DB migration risk

decisions.canonical_text: v3 launch date is April 15
decisions.rationale: Redline pilot starts Apr 20

decisions.canonical_text: v3 launch slips to mid-May (target week of May 11)
decisions.rationale: 41 open P1 bugs plus the migration collision

decisions.canonical_text: Cut offline mode from v3; ship it in v3.1
decisions.decider: Priya (recorded in Lena's recap of the Apr 2 product meeting)
decisions.rationale: biggest schedule risk (~6 engineer-weeks)

decisions.canonical_text: Re-add a read-only offline mode (cached routes and manifests, no edits) to v3
decisions.rationale: Redline made it a renewal condition; read-only costs ~1.5 engineer-weeks

decisions.canonical_text: Build the driver app in React Native
decisions.rationale: one codebase, team knows JS

decisions.canonical_text: Phased rollout: 20% of accounts on Wed May 13, 100% by May 27
decisions.rationale: limit blast radius after the migration

decisions.canonical_text: Open one senior backend engineer role, budget up to EUR 95k
decisions.rationale: backend capacity bottleneck

decisions.canonical_text: Make an offer to Elena Voss at EUR 92k + 0.15% options
decisions.rationale: strongest interview loop (Jonas and Dev scores); runner-up Mark Teller weaker on systems design

decisions.canonical_text: Try no-meeting Wednesdays company-wide
decisions.decider: Marta (implicit: 'ok let's try it for a few weeks')
decisions.rationale: proposal by Ingrid

decisions.canonical_text: Suspend no-meeting Wednesdays until June 15 (launch rollout needs daily syncs)
decisions.rationale: launch rollout needs daily syncs

decisions.canonical_text: Engage Kofi Mensah as a part-time QA contractor (3 days/week) instead of hiring a full-time QA
decisions.rationale: cost; Kofi available from the 20th

decisions.canonical_text: Offer Redline Couriers a 15% discount for a 2-year renewal
decisions.decider: Tomas (claims Marta approved; no supporting email)
decisions.rationale: win the renewal
decisions.authority_flag: Tomas may only discount <= 5%; 15% exceeded his authority

decisions.canonical_text: Cap the Redline renewal discount at 10% (2-year term)
decisions.rationale: gross-margin floor of 68%

decisions.canonical_text: Decline Swiftbox's request for a 99.99% uptime SLA; offer 99.9% with service credits
decisions.rationale: cannot guarantee 99.99% on current architecture; credit exposure

decisions.canonical_text: Harbor Express: suspend service at 60 days overdue, terminate at 90 days unless paid (EUR 27,400 overdue)
decisions.rationale: collection policy

decisions.canonical_text: Rotate ALL API keys and customer integration tokens immediately
decisions.rationale: a key was found in a public fork of a repo

decisions.canonical_text: Notify the 9 affected customers within 72 hours of discovery (by 2026-03-06)
decisions.rationale: data-protection notification duty

decisions.canonical_text: Require 2FA on all staff accounts by April 3
decisions.rationale: security follow-up after key leak

decisions.canonical_text: Hire Blackthorn Audit for a pentest, EUR 12,000, scheduled for the week of June 1
decisions.rationale: Swiftbox's security questionnaire requires a third-party pentest
decisions.alternatives: Greyline (EUR 9k, not accepted by Swiftbox); skip

decisions.canonical_text: Renew the Rotterdam office lease for 12 months at the current EUR 6,200/month
decisions.rationale: stability

decisions.canonical_text: Sublet half the office from June 1
decisions.rationale: ~40% of staff remote; recovers ~EUR 3,100/month

decisions.canonical_text: Sponsor LogiConnect Europe at the Silver tier (EUR 6,000)
decisions.rationale: lead generation

decisions.canonical_text: Downgrade to booth-only (EUR 2,500); drop the sponsorship
decisions.rationale: cash priority after migration costs; Silver benefits limited

decisions.canonical_text: Keep the Parcelwise name; no rebrand
decisions.rationale: trademark/rebrand cost (>= EUR 8k) and customer recognition

decisions.canonical_text: Replace the Helpdesk support tool with Beacon Desk effective July 1
decisions.rationale: Helpdesk renewal +40%; Beacon integrates with our API

decisions.canonical_text: First-response SLA for Pro customers
decisions.rationale: Version A (Aisha; Lena's recap): 2 business hours. Version B (Tomas, Samir): 1 hour, promised to Carla at Swiftbox on 2026-04-03 in writing

decisions.canonical_text: On-call rotation membership
decisions.rationale: Version A (Dev, standup recap): weekly rotation of Jonas + Ravi. Version B (Priya): includes Greg and Elena once onboarded

decisions.canonical_text: Q2 marketing budget
decisions.rationale: Version A (Chloe): EUR 40,000 approved (cites Marta's 'go' reply). Version B (Helen): EUR 30,000 approved (cites the budget sheet shared Mar 2)

non_decisions.outcome: Floated by Ingrid/Chloe; Marta: 'let's revisit after launch.' Never revisited.
Tomas pushed for Portuguese customers; Marta: 'interesting. not now.'
Owen proposed by phone; Marta asked Helen for numbers; Helen raised valuation questions; no conclusion.
Chloe's proposal; Helen skeptical; Priya neutral; thread trails off.
Marta: 'maybe Q3 if the numbers allow.'
Ingrid: 'I will draft a proposal.' Marta: 'send it.' No later message.
Lena asked; forwarded a vendor quote; nobody with authority replied.

non_decisions.topic: Launch in the US in Q4
non_decisions.outcome: Tomas: conditional on Redline signing the 2-year renewal; Redline hadn't signed by 06-30 (Bruno: 'signing in July').
